stage_1_immune_flag.rationale: Buffy coat is approximately 70% immune cells. The architectural class measured in Stage 1 is immune, regardless of which disease is being flagged. Breast ductal secretory tissue is not in the sample at Stage 1.

panel.source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. J Natl Cancer Inst 2020;112(1):87-94

stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method: pooled entropy A-score (mean across panel), plus optional Xu-6 subset directional
stage_1_immune_flag.biological_interpretation: Pre-malignant architectural drift triggers chronic immune activation detectable 2 to 10+ years before clinical diagnosis. Signal attenuates closer to diagnosis as immunoediting establishes tumor immune escape (Dunn-Old-Schreiber). Signal is loudest before the tumor has learned to silence it.

VAL_047_phase9_GSE51057.cohort: GSE51057 EPIC-Italy, n=329 (146 C50 cases + 177 controls)

VAL_047_phase12_GSE51032.cohort: GSE51032 EPIC-HuGeF, n=648 usable (224 C50 breast cases + 424 controls) plus other cancer types
VAL_047_phase12_GSE51032.replication_verdict: CONFIRMED — independent EPIC-Italy cohort, same panel, same H_min, same pipeline, monotonic increase with TtD window preserved, magnitudes within expected cohort-variation range

validation_anchors.temporal_pattern: Monotonic increase in |Cohen's d| with longer pre-diagnostic interval across both cohorts. Signal is detectable at cohort level 0-2yr pre-dx (d ≈ +0.09 to +0.27), strengthens 2-5yr (d ≈ +0.31 to +0.65), continues strengthening 5-10yr (d ≈ +0.71 to +0.92), and peaks >10yr (d ≈ +1.36 to +1.78).

cross_population_support.cross_population_verdict: 5 of 5 sub-cohorts direction-positive across 4 populations (Australian HBOC, UK, Polish, Singapore Chinese). Magnitude varies but direction is preserved.

NORMAL.action: No further workup. Serial-sample next interval.

MARGINAL.action: Note, no immediate action. Serial-sample in 6 months.

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2 localization. If breast_ductal localizes, recommend breast imaging.

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2 localization. Clinical workup regardless of localization.

stage_1_immune_flag.tier_source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference table (Hannum 2013, Horvath 2013, Roadmap 2015, Moss 2018, Lister 2013, Alisch 2012). See Evidence Report §5A healthy baselines section.

stage_2_localization.trigger: Stage 1 flag at DETECTABLE tier or higher
stage_2_localization.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the same IDAT into 18 per-tissue beta values
stage_2_localization.engine_status: G-DECONV-001 module OPEN-DEFERRED in GitHub roadmap; VAL-041 proved the workflow using scipy.optimize.nnls on published beta values; production module requires 30 MB Moss reference matrix and Salas 2018 QC harness

breast_specific_expectation.expected_delta_A_at_breast_ductal: ≥ +0.08 (VAL-041 reports breast plasma ΔA-above-healthy at breast_ductal of this magnitude when tissue-deconvolved)
breast_specific_expectation.discriminator_vs_other_cancers: Breast: breast_ductal ΔA elevated; hepatocyte, pancreatic_exocrine, prostate_epithelial, colon_epithelial, lung_epithelial all near healthy. This is the specificity.

VAL_041.cohort: 10 cancer types, 107 cases total drawn from Moss 2018 Fig 4 + Liu 2020 Ann Oncol Table S3
VAL_041.result: 10/10 top-1 correct localization, mean max ΔA = +0.174
VAL_041.breast_specific: Moss 2018 Fig 4c: breast_ductal beta 0.621 vs healthy 0.744 (ΔA large positive). All 8 other tissues in the deconvolution near healthy β.

interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_breast_ductal_and_delta_A_exc: HIGH-CONFIDENCE breast localization — breast card fires
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_breast_ductal_but_top2_tissue: AMBIGUOUS — report both tissues, flag for clinician interpretation
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_NOT_breast_ductal: Breast card does NOT fire. Card for the localized tissue fires instead (if defined). If no card defined for localized tissue, report as 'localization outside current Cookbook scope'.
interpretation_rules.if_no_tissue_exceeds_tier_threshold_at_S: Proceed to Stage 3 (EpiDISH immune sub-composition). Non-solid-organ immune drift pattern.

temporal_pattern_v23.source: VAL-096 (window-stratified Loyfer 25-tile per-tile A-scores on GSE51057 + GSE51032)
temporal_pattern_v23.long_pre_dx_pattern: Distributed cellular-aging-drift across pancreatic + cycling-class tiles at d=+0.5 to +1.0; breast tile reads near-null (|d|<=0.20) at >10yr/5-10yr/2-5yr
temporal_pattern_v23.near_dx_pattern_0_to_2yr: Breast tile rises to d=+0.43 (GSE51057) / d=+0.49 (GSE51032). Pancreatic-duct and head/neck-larynx tiles attenuate. Immune-class tiles show sign-flip in both cohorts (CCL-035 candidate).
temporal_pattern_v23.two_component_temporal_model: Persistent multi-tissue cellular-aging-drift signal precedes localization by 10+ years; late-localizing breast tile signal emerges 24 months pre-clinical-diagnosis; the two are additive at 0-2yr, not mutually exclusive.
temporal_pattern_v23.reporting_rule_added_v23: For samples at long pre-dx, Stage 2 reports describe the distributed pattern explicitly rather than asserting breast localization. Breast localization claim requires 0-2yr window or paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal evidence (VAL-060).
temporal_pattern_v23.ccl_candidate: CCL-035 (immune-tile inversion-near-diagnosis) — flagged for further investigation

stage_3_subcomposition.applicability: Only if Stage 1 flags but Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. For breast cases, Stage 3 is typically not triggered because Stage 2 localization to breast_ductal is the expected clean result.

production_atlas_v23.name: Salas Blood.EPIC IDOL (or Salas 450K legacy on legacy cohorts)

overlay_atlas_v23.name: UniLIFE Guo 2025 (added 2026-04-26 per Heath sign-off)
overlay_atlas_v23.production_decision: Salas remains primary; UniLIFE added as adult-specific subtype overlay; reports cite both when UniLIFE subtype d exceeds replication threshold

stage_3_subcomposition.run_everything_architecture: Per Heath sign-off 2026-04-26 (memory note 'EDEAR RUN-EVERYTHING'): every IDAT runs Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 with ALL panels/atlases regardless of any stage result. No conditional gating. Salas + UniLIFE both compute on every Stage 3 invocation.

mandatory_elements: Tier call (NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE / URGENT / FLOOR_BREACH)
If Stage 2 run: 18-tissue ΔA table with top-3 highlighted
Stage 2 confidence indicator (top-1 vs top-2 ratio)
Assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers / L2 custom capture / L3 full MESA+DELFI)
Salas 2018 QC bounds check status on immune sub-composition
report_contents.language_discipline: Report must use 'consistent with' / 'architectural signal detected' / 'elevated above age-matched baseline' — NEVER 'confirms', 'validates', 'proves'. Report elevated A-scores as flags, not diagnoses.

validation_tier: cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts — SHA-verified independent replication on GSE51057 and GSE51032, both EPIC-Italy, both 450K, same panel, same H_min, same pipeline. Direction preserved. Magnitude monotonic with TtD window in both cohorts.
known_limitations: Single-timepoint sensitivity at 95% specificity: 14-20% at d ≈ 0.6. Deployment model is serial-sample trajectory, not single-shot screening.

No covariate adjustment in the validation (no BMI, smoking, menopause, Houseman deconvolution). Published analyses of the same cohorts with covariate adjustment report comparable or stronger effects. Our numbers are a lower bound.

Stage 2 deconvolution production module (G-DECONV-001) is OPEN-DEFERRED. Current claim is validated at VAL-041 level (published-β deconvolution, 10/10 correct); production per-IDAT deployment requires module completion.

Both validation cohorts are EPIC-Italy. Cross-population evidence from CROSS_POPULATION_MANIFEST v1.2 is directionally supportive across 4 populations but magnitudes vary. Prospective validation on a non-Italian cohort with pre-frozen methodology is the next evidence tier.

0-2yr pre-dx window shows weaker signal than 2-5yr and longer windows. Clinical interpretation: EDEAR is most informative as a decade-scale early warning, not a near-diagnosis confirmation. Near-diagnosis signal attenuates due to immune escape.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned._purpose: Disease-specific quirks encountered during validation and deployment. Per-card complement to the master LESSONS_LEARNED.md catalog.

lessons.context: GSE51057 EPIC-Italy cohort, n=329, nested case-control
lessons.quirk: The pooled-entropy immune A-score with Xu-538 panel produces d=+0.71 at 5-10yr pre-diagnosis window on breast cancer — stronger at longer windows than 0-2yr, which attenuates to d=+0.37.
lessons.interpretation: The 0-2yr near-dx attenuation is consistent with immune escape as tumors crystallize. Card deployment should prefer 2-5yr or longer pre-dx windows for highest signal.
lessons.applied_to_card: Tier thresholds anchored to 2-5yr pre-dx performance; near-dx is noted as weaker in known_limitations.

lessons.context: GSE51032 replication, same EPIC-Italy population, independent nesting
lessons.quirk: Breast signal d=+0.65 at 2-5yr pre-dx replicates cleanly across Phase 9 and Phase 12. Same platform, same population, different nesting. Demonstrates the signal is not a Phase 9-specific artifact.
lessons.interpretation: Cross-platform validation would require a non-EPIC-Italy cohort (UK Biobank, Sister Study). Cross-nesting in the same population is a weaker form of replication than cross-cohort.
lessons.applied_to_card: Tier is cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts with explicit acknowledgment that both are EPIC-Italy; a truly cross-population run is listed as next_validation_step.

lessons.quirk: The entropy-based immune A-score reaches comparable discriminative power (AUC ~0.65-0.70) to the elastic-net ML benchmark without training, without feature selection, without any breast-specific CpG selection. The Xu-538 panel was selected for breast-cancer association but the A-score mechanism is class-level architectural drift, not breast-specific signal.
lessons.interpretation: This is the cleanest existing demonstration that class-level architectural scoring is competitive with disease-specific ML in pre-diagnostic cancer detection. Worth flagging for acquisition discussions.
lessons.applied_to_card: validation_tier_rationale mentions the Kresovich 2022 benchmark as competitive-performance anchor.

lessons.context: TCGA-BRCA HM450 matched tumor-vs-adjacent-normal subset (n=89 Primary Tumor + n=89 Solid Tissue Normal, 86 complete patient pairs after valid-score filtering ≥300 CpG coverage). Xu-538 pooled-entropy A-score, same pipeline as blood validation, z-standardized within-cohort Solid Tissue Normal baseline per CCL-004 (80-cell blood baseline does NOT apply to tissue). Pre-reg SHA cd8c6de4383d87203ad8ee14db6d197635021a5e036e29f3219a613b112e8fea sealed 2026-04-24 08:14:36 UTC before any TCGA β-value access; aggregate cohort SHA a11efdabfe2aec78d323371ce2687dbadaa506ce44be3229ee10c79fb3c97742; RNG seed 20260420.
lessons.quirk: The Xu-538 panel was selected by Xu 2020 (JNCI 112:87-94) from Sister Study blood methylation for breast cancer pre-diagnostic detection — a blood-derived panel for pre-diagnosis. Applied without modification to TCGA-BRCA tumor tissue with z-standardization to within-cohort adjacent-normal baseline, the panel produces unpaired Cohen's d = +0.745 [95% CI +0.451, +1.075] (permutation p = 0.0001) and paired d = +0.676 on the 86 matched patient pairs (sign-flip permutation p = 0.0001) — LARGER than VAL-058 prostate-epic tissue (paired d = +0.497) on the same panel. Per-CpG direction balance is 50.4% hypermethylated / 49.6% hypomethylated in tumor vs adjacent-normal (115 of 500 CpGs at |Δβ| > 0.05); the pooled-entropy A-score detects architectural drift regardless of individual CpG direction balance.
lessons.interpretation: The panel's underlying signal is architectural drift, not blood-immune-compartment drift specifically. The same Xu-538 + same H_min(immune) = 0.838889 + same pipeline produces consistent positive signals across (1) pre-diagnostic blood leukocyte methylation (GSE51057 + GSE51032, d = +0.45 to +0.71 pooled rising to ~+1.4 to +1.8 at >10yr), (2) adjacent-normal tissue field effect (VAL-039 Teschendorff 2016), and (3) tumor tissue (VAL-060 paired d = +0.676). Tissue effect size LARGER than prostate is consistent with Xu-538 being the panel originally selected for breast cancer — the disease it was trained on produces the largest tissue response. A panel cross-applied to prostate (different disease, different tissue class at Stage 2) still produces a clearly positive and statistically significant signal, but smaller. The framework's prediction that architectural drift is a real, measurable property of the cancer progression trajectory — not an artifact of any single specimen type — is supported by cross-substrate consistency. Per CCL-004 the within-cohort adjacent-normal Z-standardization is required for tissue scoring; the 80-cell blood baseline does not transfer to tissue specimens.
lessons.applied_to_card: VAL-060 added as the tissue_arm_VAL060 block in card v2.2 (and preserved in v2.3). Card primary tier remains cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts; tissue arm tier `tissue_arm_validated` is an additive evidence layer, not a replacement for blood pre-dx validation. README v2.2 documents the cross-substrate consistency picture (blood pre-dx + adjacent-normal field effect + tumor tissue, all with the same Xu-538 + same H_min). VAL-060 is the first retroactive per-card tissue re-validation under CCL-011 (every card gets its own tissue arm; existing cards upgrade retroactively); it established the template that VAL-061/062 (CRC), VAL-063 (lung), VAL-064 (HCC) followed.

lessons.context: GSE51057 + GSE51032 EPIC-Italy buffy-coat blood, breast pre-dx, Stage 2 25-tile Loyfer/Moss array atlas, all 4 TTD windows
lessons.quirk: At long pre-dx windows (>10yr, 5-10yr, 2-5yr) Stage 2 signal is distributed across pancreatic + cycling-class tiles (d=+0.5 to +1.0), with the breast tile itself reading near-null (|d|≤0.20). Breast tile rises to d=+0.43/+0.49 only at 0-2yr near clinical diagnosis. Both cohorts agree on the temporal trajectory.
lessons.interpretation: Two-component temporal model: a persistent multi-tissue cellular-aging-drift signal precedes localization by 10+ years; a late-localizing breast tile signal emerges in the 24 months before clinical diagnosis. The two are additive at 0-2yr. Stage 2 reports for samples at long pre-dx should not over-claim breast-tissue-of-origin attribution; the localization step happens near diagnosis. VAL-060 (paired d=+0.676 tumor vs adjacent-normal) and VAL-096 0-2yr breast tile are the cleanest pieces of breast-localized Stage 2 evidence.
lessons.applied_to_card: Stage 2 temporal pattern section added to README v2.3. Stage 2 reports for long pre-dx now flag the distributed pattern explicitly rather than asserting breast localization.

lessons.context: GSE51057 + GSE51032, head-to-head Stage 3 deconvolution: UniLIFE Guo 2025 (1906 CpGs × 19 immune cell types) vs Salas Blood.450K legacy (350 CpGs × 6 cell types)
lessons.quirk: UniLIFE 19-cell resolution surfaces two replicating breast pre-diagnostic immune signatures that Salas 6-cell pooled deconvolution does not surface at the same magnitude: aTreg at >10yr (d=+1.26/+0.79, both 95% CIs exclude zero) and aBnv at 0-2yr (d=+0.44/+0.49, both CIs exclude zero). Pan-lifespan UniLIFE markers mostly mirror Salas 6-cell signal — the resolution gain sits in the 12 adult-specific subtypes.
lessons.interpretation: Salas catches the broad pre-diagnostic immune-phenotype shift correctly. UniLIFE adds specific resolution gains in the regulatory T-cell and naive B-cell compartments. Production Stage 3 does not need to change for v2.3; UniLIFE is added as an adult-specific subtype overlay, not a replacement.
lessons.applied_to_card: Card v2.3 stage_3_subcomposition documents Salas as production baseline plus UniLIFE as adult-specific subtype overlay. Customer reports cite both layers when UniLIFE adult-specific subtypes show signal exceeding their replication thresholds.

lessons.context: GSE51057 + GSE51032, EpiSCORE BreastRef mref (DNAm-derived 8-cell-type breast reference, 7 cell types after dropping 'weight' col) Stage 2 sub-cell-type resolution test
lessons.quirk: All 7 EpiSCORE BreastRef cell types (Basal, Endothelial, Adipocyte, Fibroblast, Luminal, tissue-Lymphocyte, tissue-Macrophage) produce nearly identical per-window d values across all 4 TTD windows in both cohorts (within 0.10-0.16 of each other in every window × cohort cell). At >10yr GSE51057 EpiSCORE produces d=+1.01-+1.17 across all 7 cell types where the Loyfer/Moss bulk-breast tile reads d=+0.20; this discrepancy does not replicate to GSE51032 (d=+0.20-+0.33). Resolution-collapse pattern.
lessons.interpretation: EpiSCORE's gene-symbol-indexed reference, bridged to 450K CpGs via probeInfo450k, picks up CpGs that cluster in correlated genomic regions across the 7 sub-cell types. At buffy-coat input the panel does not separate into 7 independent tile readings. EpiSCORE remains useful for cross-tissue cell-of-origin attribution (which of the 14 EpiSCORE tissues is most consistent with the customer's signal) but is not useful for sub-cell-type resolution within the breast tile.
lessons.applied_to_card: EpiSCORE BreastRef NOT added to card v2.3 as a per-sub-cell-type discriminator. EpiSCORE 14-tissue cross-tissue attribution remains available via the atlas vault for run-everything Stage 2 cell-of-origin queries.

validation_evidence_summary.purpose: Stage 2 25-tile per-class A-score on GSE51057 + GSE51032 at >10yr breast pre-dx
validation_evidence_summary.headline: Pancreatic and cycling-class tiles concordant elevation; breast tile reads near-null at >10yr

validation_evidence_summary.purpose: EpiSCORE BreastRef 7-cell Stage 2 resolution test on same cohorts, all 4 TTD windows
validation_evidence_summary.headline: 7 EpiSCORE sub-cell types behave as one coherent signal — resolution-collapse pattern; not added to card
validation_evidence_summary.method: EpiSCORE BreastRef mref (468 markers Entrez-ID) bridged to 450K CpGs via probeInfo450k, top-80 specificity per cell type, A-score against secretory H_min 0.8433

validation_evidence_summary.purpose: UniLIFE 19-cell vs Salas 450K 6-cell head-to-head Stage 3 deconvolution on same cohorts, all 4 TTD windows
validation_evidence_summary.headline: Two replicating resolution gains: aTreg at >10yr (d=+1.26/+0.79) and aBnv at 0-2yr (d=+0.44/+0.49)
validation_evidence_summary.production_decision: Salas Blood.EPIC IDOL remains production Stage 3; UniLIFE added as adult-specific subtype overlay

validation_evidence_summary.headline: Two-component temporal model: persistent distributed cellular-aging-drift + late-localizing breast tile
validation_evidence_summary.ccl_candidate: CCL-035 candidate — immune-tile inversion-near-diagnosis pattern across multiple immune tiles in both cohorts

tissue_arm_VAL060.method: Xu-538 pooled-entropy A-score, same pipeline as blood validation, z-standardized within-cohort Solid Tissue Normal baseline (per CCL-004: 80-cell blood baseline does NOT apply to tissue).
tissue_arm_VAL060.interpretation: Xu-538 immune panel, originally derived from Sister Study blood methylation for breast cancer pre-diagnostic detection, transfers cleanly to breast tumor tissue with paired d = +0.676 on matched tumor-vs-adjacent-normal samples. Effect size is LARGER than prostate tissue (VAL-058 paired d = +0.497), consistent with breast being the disease the panel was originally selected for. The panel captures architectural drift detectable at the tissue level regardless of per-CpG direction balance (50.4% hypermeth / 49.6% hypometh — pooled-entropy A-score captures drift agnostic of direction). This tissue arm adds independent validation support to the existing blood pre-dx validation (GSE51057 + GSE51032). The breast-epic card's architectural basis is multi-substrate confirmed: blood leukocyte drift at pre-diagnosis AND tumor tissue at diagnosis both detectable with the same panel + same H_min + same pipeline.
tissue_arm_VAL060.tier_contribution: Does NOT change primary tier (cross_platform_validated_two_cohorts) but adds tissue-arm validation as an independent evidence layer.

VAL-096 TTD-window stratification on Loyfer 25-tile per-tile A-scores: two-component temporal model documented — persistent distributed cellular-aging-drift across pancreatic + cycling-class tiles at all pre-dx windows, plus late-localizing breast tile (d=+0.43 / +0.49 at 0-2yr in both cohorts).
Stage 2 temporal pattern section added to README; Stage 2 reports for samples at long pre-dx no longer over-claim breast-tissue-of-origin attribution.

Three new lessons: breast-LL-005 (Stage 2 distributed-then-localized), breast-LL-006 (UniLIFE 19-cell additive resolution gain at aTreg/aBnv), breast-LL-007 (EpiSCORE breast sub-cell-type resolution does not separate at buffy-coat input).

Direct-to-consumer positioning block (deployment_positioning_v23) added at top-level of card per Heath 2026-04-26 — EDEAR is a health-and-wellness tool, not a medical diagnostic; out-of-pocket, no FDA, no clinician-in-the-loop in v1. Customer is the primary reader. README v2.3 'What EDEAR is and is not' section communicates this to anyone reading the card. Existing technical sections (stage_2_localization tier thresholds, healthy reference β values, A_ceiling values, clinical action matrices) are the report engine's operational spec — preserved verbatim. Customer-facing language calibration happens at the report-rendering layer, not in the technical card spec.

deployment_positioning_v23.regulatory_status: Not FDA-approved. Not a medical diagnostic. Health-and-wellness only.
deployment_positioning_v23.ordering_pathway: Consumer purchases directly. No clinician required to order or interpret.
deployment_positioning_v23.report_recipient: Customer (consumer). The customer is the primary reader of the report.
deployment_positioning_v23.what_edear_does: Reports where the customer's cells sit, by architecture class, relative to age-matched healthy reference, at the moment of the draw. Trajectory across serial samples is the primary product.
what_edear_does_not_do: Does not diagnose breast cancer or any other disease
Does not predict cancer at long pre-diagnostic windows (long pre-dx signals are body-wide cellular-aging-drift, not disease-specific)
Does not require a clinician to order, interpret, or act on
Does not replace standard-of-care screening (mammography, etc. continue per the customer's own healthcare decisions)
deployment_recommendation_to_customer: Treat single readings as one coordinate; treat the trajectory across multiple readings as the story
Annual or biannual draws build the personal baseline against which drift becomes visible
Layer EDEAR onto blood draws already happening (annual physicals, lipid panels, A1C, life-insurance, pre-employment) — same blood
Pair the report with lifestyle decisions the customer already controls (sleep, food, exercise, stress, smoking, alcohol, weight)
Read multi-class drift as 'the system as a whole is showing wear, continue monitoring' rather than 'I have disease X'

For breast specifically: the localized signal emerges only in the 24 months before clinical diagnosis. Long pre-dx is body-wide drift, not breast-specific. Customer reports communicate this distinction explicitly.
deployment_positioning_v23.language_calibration_in_customer_facing_: Customer-facing language uses cellular-state and trajectory framing. Disease-specific tissue-of-origin attribution is communicated only when the data support it (0-2yr window for breast per VAL-096). The technical sections of this card (stage_2_localization tier thresholds, healthy reference β values, A_ceiling values, clinical action matrices below) are the report engine's operational spec — they govern what the engine computes; the customer-facing report renders those computations in cellular-state language calibrated to what the data support.
